[F001] ## Summary

Implemented F001 — `claude/skills/changelog/` — as a deterministic, fixture-testable skill. Wrote `SKILL.md` (conformant frontmatter + Purpose/Arguments/Prerequisites/Steps/Output/Examples), `changelog.py` (with `parse_git_log`, `group_by_type`, `render_markdown`, `render_json`, and a CLI that runs `git log` against the working tree or reads `--fixtures <dir>/git_log.txt`), five fixtures (nominal/empty/non_conventional/single_commit/merge_commit) each with `git_log.txt`, `meta.json`, and a recorded golden `expected.md` (plus `expected.json` for nominal), and 19 pytest cases covering byte-for-byte golden equality, Conventional-Commits classification (including scope and `!` breaking marker), graceful empty-range handling, fallback to `other`, merge-commit retention with a `[merge]` tag, the `--out` and `--fixtures` flags, and a no-network defensive check. Added namespace `__init__.py` files at `claude/`, `claude/skills/`, and `claude/skills/changelog/` so `python -m claude.skills.changelog.changelog` resolves. Registered the skill in `claude/RESOLVER.md` with trigger keywords `["changelog", "release notes", "commit summary", "what changed"]`. All four verification commands pass: pytest 19/19 green, resolver `validate.py` exits 0 with `WARN (0 errors, 63 warnings)` — exactly the post-#692 baseline (zero NEW issues), `sanitization_check.py` clean (384 files), `jarvis_doctor.py --skip-auth` 13/13.
